event.loss: some scrap metals were stolen from the barge

sources.title: Piracy monthly report August 2025
sources.text: While the tug boat towing barge loaded with scrap metal was underway, 10 perpetrators in nine sampans came alongside the barge and removed some scrap metals from the deck of the barge. The crew was not injured. The master reported the incident to Singapore Vessel Traffic Information System (VTIS) East. At the time of the incident, HK Tug 8 was towing barge LKH 2882 loaded with scrap metal from Singapore to Phu My, Vietnam.
